title: angelica angustifolia
intro: Angelica angustifolia, commonly known as Rocky Mountain angelica or narrow-leaved angelica, is a perennial plant belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is used in traditional medicine to promote digestive health, relieve menstrual cramps, and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of Angelica angustifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiemetic properties, which make it a popular herbal remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Angelica angustifolia include sesquiterpenes, lignans, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
